12 · TERMS & CONDITIONS

Know the essentials
before you book.

Self-Drive

  • Security deposit applies and is confirmed before booking.
  • Mileage allowance follows rental period.
  • Excess mileage: RM1/km.
  • Customer is responsible for the vehicle during the rental.
  • Vehicle condition is checked before and after rental.
  • Delivery / collection is available within Klang Valley only.

Chauffeur

  • No security deposit for chauffeur service.
  • Hourly minimum: 3 hours.
  • One-Way and Drop & Pick have no 3-hour minimum.
  • Airport waiting: 60 minutes complimentary after actual landing.
  • Hotel / normal pickup waiting: 15 minutes complimentary.
  • Additional waiting: RM50/hour.

Outstation & Parking

  • Outstation pricing is destination-based lump sum.
  • Standard toll and normal parking are bundled where applicable.
  • Premium, valet, overnight or special-access charges may be additional.
  • Additional destinations may incur RM50–RM100.
  • Extreme routes / special requirements are quoted.

Booking Policy

  • Availability is not guaranteed until KMS confirms.
  • Date/time changes are subject to availability.
  • Urgent same-day chauffeur requests may carry RM100 surcharge.
  • Wedding, corporate and long-rental package details require confirmation.
  • VIP priority consideration does not override an existing confirmed booking.
Rates and terms shown are customer-facing guide rates. KMS confirmation is required before any booking is considered confirmed.
